name: smith unilateral bulgarian split squat from deficit
description: A Bulgarian split squat on a Smith machine with the front foot raised, giving extra depth for quads and glutes.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.
